formulas.ascii: r = S_xy / sqrt(S_xx S_yy) over the N listed pairs i < j. By default, x = spatial distance, y = |t_i - t_j|; supplied distanceTransform and timeTransform instead use (value + constant)^power for the respective pair values. S_xy = sum xy - sum x sum y / N, S_xx = sum xx - (sum x)^2 / N, S_yy likewise. r is undefined (NaN) when N < 2 or either norm is zero; the observed pair count N is retained. U contains only finite null statistics in slots 1 through attempted permutationCount inclusive; unused capacity slots never enter U. For fixed-count inference with M usable null draws, p = (1 + #{usable draws s with r_s >= r}) / (M + 1): one-sided (positive space-time correlation), +1 counts the observed value, ties count as exceedances. Unusable draws retain NaN slots and do not enter either tail or its denominator. If the observed correlation is undefined or M = 0, inference is unavailable (NaN), not p = 1. With stopAfterExceedances h reached, the greater-tail estimate is min(1, h / M); attempted permutationCount and usablePermutationCount are distinct.
